items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: China's Supply Chokehold and the Pricing Hangover. Chinese refining capacity and low-cost domestic output pushed the market into surplus for years, and the hangover persists. JPMorgan analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas recently cut Albemarle's 2026 adjusted EBITDA estimate by 14.4% to $2.

items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: The appointment brings a senior mining executive with experience across major commodity markets into Albemarle at a consequential point for the global lithium industry. Albemarle announced earlier this year that it would idle its Kemerton lithium hydroxide processing plant in Aus

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Albemarle faces delays at the Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire. Albemarle shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) will likely benefit from factors like its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, as well as continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties, RBC Capital Markets said. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $1

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
